feature_analysis.protocol: Same classifier hyperparameters and sampler; preprocessing and SHAP ranking fit on training only. K=40 and ablation K=5 fixed in advance. Threshold=0.5 for all configurations. All cleaned features excludes only missingness/constant columns, not MI/correlation selection. Single held-out split; exploratory, no significance or improvement claim.

distribution_shift.protocol: Synthetic +0.5 training SD offset on five training-SHAP-ranked features; labels held fixed as a stress-test assumption. Not observed production drift or measured causal outcomes.
